title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Collection
overview:
A gallery disc of computer-generated portraits of the Virtua Fighter cast. It holds 22 CG images in all: two for each fighter plus two of Dural.

Browse the collection with the control pad, select a portrait to view it, zoom in and out with the shoulder buttons, and return the image to its original size at any time. The disc was included as a bonus with Virtua Fighter Remix.
